campuses.title: Dubai Knowledge Park Campus
campuses.text: Кампус EM Normandie в Dubai открыт в 2022 — 1,400 m² в Dubai Knowledge Park рядом с Palm Jumeirah. 7 учебных и образовательных пространств, social area, break areas. Напротив штаб-квартир Dell Technologies, Cisco Systems, Huawei, Amazon Services.

paragraphs: EM Normandie Business School is a French Grande École founded in 1871, making it one of the oldest business schools in France and worldwide. The school holds the prestigious triple accreditation — AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA — placing it among the top 1% of business schools globally. With 5,800 students from 65 nationalities, EM Normandie operates campuses in Caen, Le Havre, Paris, Oxford, Dublin and Dubai.

The Dubai campus was inaugurated in 2022 in Dubai Knowledge Park, an academic free-zone near Palm Jumeirah Island and other renowned international universities. The 1,400 m² facility includes 7 teaching spaces, student lounges and break areas. The campus sits across from the regional headquarters of Dell Technologies, Cisco Systems, Huawei and Amazon Services — embedding students in Dubai's technology and innovation ecosystem.

All programmes at the Dubai campus are taught 100% in English. The Dubai campus offers the Bachelor in Management, International Bachelor in Business Administration, Master in Management (Programme Grande École) and a portfolio of MSc programmes covering Finance, FinTech, Data Sciences, Digital Strategy, Marketing, Luxury, Supply Chain, Sustainable Finance and Sustainable Business Strategy.

Dubai is consistently ranked the best student city in the Middle East by QS Best Student Cities, with 200+ corporate headquarters and a globally connected airport hub. EM Normandie's Dubai cohort benefits from the school's global network of 200+ partner universities, exchange semesters across Europe, internships with multinational companies and the same EQUIS-AACSB-AMBA-accredited diploma awarded in France.
paragraphsRu: EM Normandie Business School — французская Grande École, основанная в 1871 году, одна из старейших бизнес-школ Франции и мира. Школа имеет престижную тройную аккредитацию — AACSB, EQUIS и AMBA — что ставит её в топ 1% бизнес-школ мира. 5 800 студентов из 65 национальностей, кампусы в Caen, Le Havre, Paris, Oxford, Dublin и Dubai.

Кампус в Dubai открыт в 2022 году в Dubai Knowledge Park — академическая free-zone рядом с Palm Jumeirah Island и другими известными международными университетами. Площадь 1 400 m²: 7 учебных пространств, social area, break areas. Кампус напротив региональных штаб-квартир Dell Technologies, Cisco Systems, Huawei и Amazon Services — погружение в технологическую экосистему Dubai.

Все программы на кампусе Dubai преподаются 100% на английском. На кампусе Dubai доступны Bachelor in Management, International Bachelor in Business Administration, Master in Management (Programme Grande École) и портфолио программ MSc: Finance, FinTech, Data Sciences, Digital Strategy, Marketing, Luxury, Supply Chain, Sustainable Finance и Sustainable Business Strategy.

Dubai стабильно занимает первое место среди студенческих городов Ближнего Востока по версии QS Best Student Cities — 200+ корпоративных штаб-квартир и глобальный авиа-хаб. Студенты Dubai-кампуса EM Normandie получают доступ к сети из 200+ университетов-партнёров, exchange-семестрам в Европе, стажировкам в мультинациональных компаниях и тому же диплому EQUIS-AACSB-AMBA, что выдаётся во Франции.
